experts.name: Expert A (Architecture)
experts.comments: Architecture sound. Clear module boundaries, consistent data flow, adequate error handling, backward compatibility maintained via migration mechanism.

experts.name: Expert B (Technical)
experts.comments: Technical implementation correct. All edge cases handled (empty state, legacy phases, missing fields). Concurrent safety via atomic write pattern. Performance impact minimal (O(1) read/write).

experts.name: Expert C (Feasibility)
experts.comments: Production-ready. Grace period for legacy walkthroughs prevents breaking existing workflows. Rollback strategy in place. User impact minimal (transparent migration). No regression risks identified.
